title: fynkel.CharacterController
description: A kinematic capsule walked by gameplay (blueprint §19.2d item 9, over Rapier's kinematic character controller). The entity's origin is the capsule's centre minus `center` — with the default `center` the origin is at the feet. Moved by `move`/`jump` commands (one `move` per tick; no command is standing still) or, with `move_action`/`jump_action` named, by the runtime itself from those actions (walking relative to the `fynkel.ThirdPersonCamera` that targets the entity, if any). Slopes up to `max_slope` are climbed, steeper ones slid down; steps up to `max_step_height` are climbed; gravity accumulates while airborne and the character snaps to ground within `snap_to_ground`. Ground contact, sliding and the effective velocity are held state (`characterState()`). Its own kinematic capsule replaces any `RigidBody`/`Collider` on the entity (`FYN-H0006`), collides by its object's `fynkel.Layer` and its `mask`, reports contact and trigger events and pushes dynamic bodies as a body of `mass` kilograms would.

height.description: Total capsule height (both caps included), `>= 2 * radius`.

center.description: The capsule's centre in the entity's local frame (scaled by the entity's scale, like a collider offset).

skin_width.description: Skin the controller keeps from geometry, metres, `>= 0`.

max_slope.description: Steepest climbable slope, radians in `0..pi/2`; steeper ground slides the character down.

max_step_height.description: Highest step climbed without a jump, metres (`0` disables).

snap_to_ground.description: How far below the feet ground still counts as touched when walking off a bump, metres (`0` disables).

gravity_scale.description: Multiplies the world's gravity; `0` is a flying character whose `move` velocity is used in full (vertical included).

mass.description: Kilograms the character pushes dynamic bodies with (`0` pushes nothing).

speed.description: Walk speed of the runtime driver (`move_action`), m/s.

jump_speed.description: Take-off speed of a `jump` without an explicit speed, m/s.

turn_speed.description: Radians per second the entity turns towards its horizontal motion (`0` leaves the rotation to gameplay).

move_action.description: A 2D action walked by the runtime every tick at `speed` (x right, y forward, relative to the camera that targets this entity); empty leaves movement to `move` commands.

jump_action.description: A button action whose press jumps when grounded; empty leaves it to `jump` commands.

mask.description: Which layers the capsule collides with and walks on (bit `i` = the project's `layers[i]`); its own layer is its entity's `fynkel.Layer` (ADR-0020).
